resources.string: Your teams\' next games on Home, from your own calendars
How to add calendars from a computer
Add a team\'s calendar link (from Stanza, a team\'s website, or Google Calendar\'s \"Secret address in iCal format\"), or set them all at once from a computer with setup.sh.
Updated %1$s · %2$s · links are never shown in full

Long links are easier to paste than to type with the remote. On a computer with this repository and ADB access to the TV, put one calendar per line in addons/game-day/calendars.txt as

sport | name | link

then run

TV_HOST=<tv ip> addons/game-day/setup.sh

(setup.ps1 on Windows). It replaces this list and prints how each calendar loaded. Links are never printed.
Its games leave Home. The link is deleted from the TV; your calendar itself is not touched.
Links starting with webcal:// work too
That is not a calendar link. It starts with https://, http:// or webcal://.
That calendar is already on the list.
Checked: %1$s found. The name is only for this list.
The name is empty or over 40 characters.
Left and Right to choose, Up and Down for the shade, OK to save · a dot marks a colour another calendar uses
How long each team stays on Home before the next one
10 to 120 seconds, in steps of 5 · OK to save
